issue.title: Refresh the stale bob-cli generated memory shims and sidecar guide
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-ez.4 and corroborated by sase-ez.5 during epic sase-ez (plans:202608/revert_bead_reprefix_epic.md).

Run from a bob-cli workspace, 'sase validate' fails two generated-artifact gates:

- 'sase init memory --check' reports the generated memory files and provider instruction shims need regeneration.
- 'sase init repo --check' reports the sidecar guide needs regeneration.

Both are stale generated output in the gh_bobs-org__bob-cli project, unrelated to the bead-ID reprefix that sase-ez.4 performed there (the reprefix token audit over that project is clean).

sase-ez.4 deliberately did not fix these: regenerating memory requires the project owner's explicit permission for memory-file changes, which an epic phase agent does not have.

Scope: with owner approval, run the memory and repo initialization for bob-cli, commit the regenerated files, and confirm 'sase validate' no longer reports either gate. The third 'sase validate' failure in that project, 57 prompt-in-plans-store plan-link errors, is tracked separately on sase-e0 and is not part of this task.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05: deliberately deprioritized, not fixed, and not re-verified at master 0e40decdc. The project owner capped the reviewable task backlog at five, and these are narrow-scope follow-ups that did not make the cut: sase-ec (chat payload row recency ranking in the at-reference menu), sase-ef (source-free 'sase agent prompts validate' project disambiguation), sase-eq (bead path-resolution tests picking up an ambient /tmp/sdd/beads ancestor store — environment-dependent, not an xdist flake, so not consolidated onto sase-ct), sase-ex (legacy artifact created_at offset normalization, bounded to --since/date: bucketing near local midnight), and sase-f8 (stale generated memory shims and sidecar guide in the separate gh_bobs-org__bob-cli project, which additionally needs the owner's explicit memory-file permission). Scope and evidence stay readable here, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them automatically.
